title: A Language for the Glasshouse
author: Gideon Ashgrove
blurb: Wendell Villalobos, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
